source: ashlar/3d/rig-anim/RIG_SKILL_WORKFLOW.md §4 'Ngưỡng khởi điểm' (2026-10-22). Proposal values until the P5 benchmark calibrates them; then they are copied into QA_CHECKLIST.md as the new section A3. Do not edit numbers here without changing §4 first. Light semantics refined by references/deformation-qa.md after review r1 (2026-10-23); rows that differ from §4 say so in source_note.

semantics.value: the measured quantity in 'unit'; when relative_to_H is true the value is divided by H (catalogue height, metres) before it is compared
semantics.green: [lo, hi]: green when lo <= value <= hi (null = unbounded on that side)
semantics.red: [lo, hi]: red when value < lo or value > hi (null = no red bound on that side). Between the green and the red bounds the light is yellow. When red equals green the row is pass/fail (no yellow band), which is how §4 writes single-bound rows
semantics.tolerance: numerical zero for rows written as 0 in §4 (float32 positions): values <= tolerance count as 0
semantics.evaluated_by: who measures the row: metrics (solvers/metrics.py), parity_cmp (solvers/parity_cmp.py), or another step (A1/A2/B); rows of other steps are carried so the table is complete

rows.metric: largest distance of a core bone head OUTSIDE the deformed mesh (0 = every head inside), rest and every QA pose
rows.scope: core deform bones; thin parts (ears, loincloth) are listed as exempt with the reason
rows.source_note: §4 'Đầu bone lõi nằm trong mesh: 100%; phần mỏng (tai, khố) ghi miễn' — D01 [đo]; yellow within 0.2% H of the surface added by the review r1 brief

rows.metric: joint position error against ground truth
rows.scope: core joints
rows.source_note: §4 'lõi ≤ 1% H' [đề xuất]; best learned methods ~0.5-1.5% of size

rows.metric: joint position error against ground truth
rows.scope: limb tips and aux bones
rows.source_note: §4 'ngọn chi, bone phụ ≤ 1,5% H' [đề xuất]

rows.metric: left/right joint asymmetry when the mesh is symmetric
rows.scope: sided landmarks, mirrored

rows.metric: elbow and knee pre-bend at rest
rows.scope: elbows, knees

rows.metric: A1.4-A1.7: no empty vertex, sum = 1, at most 4 influences, valid joint indices
rows.scope: all vertices of the exported skin
rows.source_note: §4 'như QA_CHECKLIST' (thresholds live in QA_CHECKLIST.md A1.4-A1.7)

rows.metric: weight difference between co-located (seam duplicate) vertices
rows.scope: weld groups
rows.source_note: §4 '≤ 1e-6' — principle 6

rows.metric: vertices with weight > 0.01 on an opposite-side bone outside the middle band
rows.scope: all vertices outside the side-gate band
rows.source_note: §4 '0 đỉnh > 0,01' [đề xuất]

rows.metric: vertices with weight on a bone outside their region's bone list
rows.scope: regions that carry a bone list (D01 sack)
rows.source_note: §4 '0 đỉnh ngoài danh sách' — D01 B1 [đo]

rows.metric: limb leak: welded rows whose nearest deform bone segment is not a limb bone (torso, neck, head, aux) and that carry >= w_min of a limb root far from it - the upper arm (+ its twist bones) farther than arm_rel x upper-arm length from the upper-arm segment, the thigh more than thigh_rel thigh lengths above the hip joint along the thigh axis; per side; the value is the number of leaking rows (union over sides and limbs)
rows.scope: every welded vertex of the weights (runtime-rule weights in metrics); skin selection gates the regions in gate_regions
rows.evaluated_by: metrics (light of the primary weights, per region for every candidate) + B skin_common.limb_leak (candidate reports) + region score gate
rows.source_note: NOT in §4: references/deformation-qa.md 'Limb leak' (review B r3). Calibrated 2026-10-23 (I2) on welded rows: D01 G2 2 rows (arm_L, w <= 0.108; 3 original vertices), FL candidate C 1 row (arm_R 0.118) are green; review B r3 candidates B: D01 96 rows, FL 677 rows (red); D01 candidate C (UniRig) 39 rows (thigh above 0.3 L). Skin selection: a candidate whose rows in a gate region exceed the green bound (3) is dropped there before the tear step, unless every candidate exceeds it (then the region is flagged for G2). Yellow 4-10 rows = a G2 question

rows.metric: mean per-vertex L1 error against authored weights (ground-truth tier 1 only)
rows.scope: benchmark assets with authored weights
rows.source_note: §4 'L1 trung bình ≤ 0,1 (theo đỉnh)' [đề xuất]

rows.metric: posed / rest edge length over the ROM set
rows.scope: every welded edge outside exempt zones, every QA pose
rows.evaluated_by: metrics (diagnostic: the band enters the region score; the light is deform_torn_edges_standard / _extreme)
rows.source_note: §4 'vàng ngoài [0,8; 1,25]; đỏ > 1,5' [đề xuất]; FL tore at > 1.5x [đo]. Since references/deformation-qa.md (review r1) max and p99 are diagnostics only; the light counts torn edges

rows.metric: torn edges (posed/rest edge ratio > torn_ratio AND growth > torn_growth_rel_H x H) in standard poses, per region
rows.scope: every welded edge outside exempt zones, poses tagged standard
rows.source_note: §4 'đỏ > 1,5' refined by references/deformation-qa.md (review r1): any torn edge in a standard pose is red

rows.metric: torn edges in extreme poses as a fraction of the region's edges (largest region)
rows.scope: every welded edge outside exempt zones, poses tagged extreme
rows.source_note: §4 'đỏ > 1,5' refined by references/deformation-qa.md (review r1): in an extreme pose red above ~0.5% of the region's edges

rows.metric: area-weighted fraction of a region's faces whose posed/rest area is beyond +-band, slivers skipped, extreme poses
rows.scope: welded triangles outside exempt zones with smallest rest angle >= sliver_min_angle_deg
rows.source_note: §4 '≤ ±15%' [đề xuất] refined by references/deformation-qa.md (review r1): area-weighted fraction, green <= 1%, red > 5%; a single worst face does not decide

rows.metric: joint volume by ball occupancy: fraction of a fixed point set in a ball of radius ball_factor x limb radius around the posed joint inside the mesh (winding number), posed / rest. Not measurable when the rest occupancy is below min_rest_occupancy x the share a centred limb-sized cylinder fills of the ball (1 for ball_factor <= 1, 1 - (1 - 1/f^2)^1.5 above)
rows.scope: shoulder, elbow, hip, knee regions from the rest weights
rows.source_note: §4 '≥ 0,85 lần rest' [đề xuất]; method from references/deformation-qa.md (review r1) (capped patches were unstable); radius suggested by the orchestrator (0.8 x local limb radius)

rows.metric: smallest forearm section ratio (posed / rest) over the slices at 0.5 / 0.75 / 0.9 of the forearm and the wrist band, forearm-twist poses
rows.scope: forearms; poses tagged forearm_twist (§4 says a 90 deg twist; the H ROM samples +-80 deg)
rows.source_note: §4 '≥ 0,7 lần rest' [đề xuất] refined by references/deformation-qa.md (review r1): minimum over the slices and the wrist band; a rig without (weighted) twist bones is never green

rows.metric: faces in new penetrating pairs between non-adjacent regions or islands, standard poses: a newly-inside vertex deeper than eps_rel_H x H (plus the rest overlap depth of the two regions when the intruding face lies within slide_radius_rel_H x H of their rest overlap: a sliding rest overlap); shallower pairs are contacts
rows.scope: poses tagged standard
rows.source_note: §4 '0 trong ROM chuẩn' [đề xuất]; eps 0.05% H and contacts from references/deformation-qa.md (review r1)

rows.metric: max depth of new penetrations (deeper than eps) in extreme poses (must also be documented)
rows.scope: poses tagged extreme
rows.source_note: §4 'tư thế cực ≤ 0,5% H và ghi rõ' [đề xuất] (~1 cm at 1.8 m): any penetration is at least yellow

rows.metric: max distance between co-located duplicate vertices after deformation
rows.scope: weld groups, every pose
rows.source_note: §4 'Nứt seam: 0'

rows.metric: Blender (runtime emulation) vs clean glTF reimport, posed vertices by welded position
rows.scope: sampled QA poses
rows.source_note: §4 '≤ 1e-4 m × H/1,8' — A1.9 (stored as 1e-4/1.8 per metre of H)

rows.metric: Blender vs three.js skinned positions (optional)
rows.scope: sampled QA poses, WebGL and WebGPU
rows.source_note: §4 '≤ 1 mm × H/1,8' [đề xuất] (stored as 1e-3/1.8 per metre of H)

rows.metric: user time per benchmark round
rows.scope: P5 benchmark
rows.source_note: §4 '≤ 2 phút mỗi vòng, 0 nếu không có cờ' — P0 decision

rows.metric: lowest sole vertex of each planted foot (deformed geometry)
rows.scope: feet tagged planted in a pose
rows.source_note: NOT in §4: references/deformation-qa.md 'Ground contact: 0 ± 3 mm'. Absolute, as written there

rows.metric: region score for skin selection (region_scores.json; no light): seam crack -> limb-leak gate (gate regions of weights_limb_leak) -> tear length (worst pose, then sum) -> penetration tier -> soft score -> near tie; regions whose joints never turn are not exercised
rows.scope: every region with edges, every weights file scored by metrics.py
rows.source_note: NOT in §4: references/deformation-qa.md 'Region score for skin selection' (reviews r1, r2). not_exercised_deg: a region is not exercised when every joint at its bones turns less than this in every pose (the reference says 'a few degrees'; 3 deg from the review r2 brief). tear_tie_rel / tear_tie_abs_units: tear lengths within max(tear_tie_rel x the smaller one, tear_tie_abs_units x 1e-4 H) are equal (reference: 'about 5%'). near_tie / soft_floor: step 5, within 5% of the best soft score (at least near_tie x soft_floor). Limb-leak gate (I2, 2026-10-23, review B r3): before the tear step, in the gate regions of weights_limb_leak, a candidate with more leaking rows in the region than that row's green bound is dropped, unless every candidate has (then the region is flagged for G2)

garment_rows_source: Phase G (2026-10-23, writer G2): references/cloth-and-attachments.md §6 'Metrics' as data. Kept out of 'rows' (the copy of RIG_SKILL_WORKFLOW.md §4); solvers.metrics.load_thresholds reads both lists. Proposal values, P5 calibrates.

garment_rows.metric: leg or arm faces in penetrating pairs with a garment piece (new pair, flood-filled newly-inside depth > eps = 0.05% H, the body penetration rule), largest count over the standard poses
garment_rows.scope: garment pieces of garments.npz vs limb regions (dominant bone UpperArm/ForeArm/Hand/Thigh/Calf/Foot/Toe and twists)
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): 'standard poses 0; extremes reported' (detail.extreme)

garment_rows.metric: faces of one garment piece / layer in penetrating pairs with another piece, largest count over the standard poses
garment_rows.scope: pairs of faces of two different pieces
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): '0'; extremes reported

garment_rows.metric: hem length posed / rest (sum of the hem edges of a piece: garments.json hem_loop, else the rows with t >= 0.95), smallest and largest over the standard poses and every piece; extreme and chain weight-test poses are reported separately (hem_stretch_extreme_*) and do not light this row (G5, 2026-10-23)
garment_rows.scope: each garment piece with a hem
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): '0.95-1.05 (green), 0.9-1.1 (yellow)'

garment_rows.metric: torn edges (ratio > 1.5 and growth > 0.2% H, the body rule) touching a garment piece, largest count over the standard poses
garment_rows.scope: edges with an end on a garment row
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): 'standard poses 0'; extremes reported

garment_rows.metric: garment rows carrying more than 1e-4 (exporter rule) of chain bones of ANOTHER piece
garment_rows.scope: garment rows; bone -> piece from skeleton.json chain bones or chains.json
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): '0' (no weight may cross from one strip to another, §5)

garment_rows.metric: welded rows where a chain bone is the dominant weight, smallest over the chain bones
garment_rows.source_note: NOT in §4: cloth-and-attachments.md §6 proposal [suy luận; P5 calibrates] (phase G, writer G2): 'at least 8 welded rows per bone, else merge the bone'; 0 rows = red (G2 inference)
